concerns: Subuh is also an ordinary Indonesian term for dawn or the pre-sunrise period, so the proposed national contrast is weak.
response.cue_rationale: Both answers can denote the early light or period before sunrise, although subuh also commonly evokes the dawn prayer or time.
material_concerns: The pairing may mislead learners into treating fajar as the normal Indonesian choice and subuh as specifically Malaysian.

preference_risk.rationale: Subuh is plausibly ordinary Indonesian for the dawn or pre-sunrise period, so the proposed preference is weaker than presented.

response.rationale: Both forms can refer to dawn, but subuh is common in Indonesian as well, especially for the dawn period or prayer time. The proposed contrast is therefore not a reliable everyday national preference.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Subuh is a common Indonesian alternative for the same dawn-period sense, weakening the claimed Indonesian–Malaysian preference.
